data.title: Unit 8 : Materials
Using materials
data.rubric: Click here to learn why we use certain materials for certain things.
data.text: Stones and bricks are used for building walls.
Cotton is used for making clothes.
A mineral from the earth called iron is used in making pots and pans.
Clay is used for making flower pots.
Plastic is used for making balls.
Wood is used in building houses.
